fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Dynamic Energy Balance (wind-dependent losses)
source: Duffie & Beckman (2013) Solar Engineering of Thermal Processes ch.6; ISO 9806:2017 (unglazed test method); Bohren & Albrecht / Soltau (1992) Heat loss coefficients for unglazed collectors, Solar Energy 49(2)

unit.name: Generic EPDM/PP Unglazed Pool Collector — Physics-Lumped

eta0.note: Zero-loss (optical) efficiency F'(tau*alpha); high, no glazing reflection (Duffie & Beckman ch.6)

b0.note: Still-air loss coefficient at zero wind (radiative + free convection)

b1.note: Wind-speed loss slope; total a1 = b0 + b1*u (ISO 9806 unglazed wind term)

bu.note: Wind dependence of optical/effective gain (eta0_eff = eta0*(1 - bu*u)), ISO 9806 unglazed

C_th.note: Effective lumped thermal capacitance per unit area (absorber + fluid hold-up, EPDM panel)

mdot.note: Specific pool water mass flow rate per unit area (high-flow pool loop)

cp_water.note: Specific heat of water at ~25 C (Duffie & Beckman App.)

epsilon.note: Long-wave emissivity of EPDM/PP absorber surface

h_evap.note: Evaporative loss coefficient for wetted/uncovered surface (0 for dry-back panel; set >0 for wetted absorber)
